facts.fact: 周一车祸消息传遍全镇：上山农夫发现残骸报警；Sarita 拉 Perla 去 Lulú 家吊唁——「那辆车被诅咒了，先被牛顶」。
facts.anchor: News of Cándido’s death spread like wildfire throughout   Puerco Ahogado on Monday.

facts.fact: 吊唁房惊魂：Bartolo 坚持起车、立死因研讯、验头部伤痕——Ulises 脊背浇冰水；Beto 笑他「读侦探小说读的」。
facts.anchor: “An inquest?” Ulises replied, surprised by the young policeman’s choice of words.

facts.fact: 疑点被提出（深夜为何在崖边）却被酒驾解释消解；Ulises 想到「那些击打」几乎当场呕吐。
facts.anchor: “I can’t imagine what he would have been doing there at that time of night,” Dr. Carrel said.

facts.fact: 深夜溜进 Inés 房：他愧疚、怕脚印怕研讯；她安抚「雨会冲掉一切」，并把 Nepomuceno 旧账重提——「偷钱和杀人不是一回事」。
facts.anchor: “Don’t worry, I’m not trying to seduce you,” he told her.

facts.fact: 床上仅止于轻触：他「捧着稀有珍贵的东西」；她摸他的唇、腹。
facts.anchor: They kissed, but curiously there was nothing lewd about the touching of their lips.

facts.fact: 周四雨停起车：车如手风琴、闭合棺下葬；九日悼开始——Lulú 以泪洗面、Zorrilla 姐妹念经、Perla 分玉米粽（神父嫌粽干粥稀）。
facts.anchor: The car was crumpled like an accordion, they said.

facts.fact: 守灵夜醋海生波：Inés 与 Bartolo 谈笑风生；他跟踪到庭院——「他怀疑不是意外」。
facts.anchor: The sight of them together soured the atole in his mouth.

facts.fact: 她转述 Bartolo 疑点：弯道打滑不该那样坠谷、深夜没理由在那儿；她承认自己「靠调情套话」稳住他。
facts.anchor: “He’s not sure what he thinks, just that it doesn’t add up.

facts.fact: 露台吵崩：他指责她调情，她反问「你吃醋？」；他毒舌回敬「你不会是谁的甜心」——她以「今晚姨妈的睡裙铺好了」收场。
facts.anchor: “Are you jealous? There’s no proper relationship between you and me. I’m not your sweetheart.”

facts.fact: 他的双重生活：口交时想着 Inés，把她比作「会咬断手的狼、宝石色毒蛙」；Bartolo 母亲到场监视野，Ulises 暗爽又同情。
facts.anchor: He closed his eyes, thought about Inés while he was fucking Perla.

facts.fact: 章末：他确认自己「白杀了人」——没拿到钱、被当男妓使唤、怕街头当乞丐；「矿脉还在」的自欺收尾。
facts.anchor: I killed a man for nothing, he thought, and tried to convince himself it had not been for nothing, that there were still riches to be mined.
